critical_steps: Douglas gives a reduced factor with squared norm 1/A.
The dual characterization transfers that norm to a dual synthesis operator.
The scalar example forces Gamma=2I when A=1/4.
integrity.proof_basis: Reciprocal comparison of the optimal lower-frame constant with the Douglas majorization constant, plus an exact one-point counterexample.
integrity.unproved_limits: No classification of all minimum-norm duals is asserted.

scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the extremal synthesis-norm constant in Theorem 2.3.
The reduced Douglas solution is uniquely normalized; no classification of all norm-minimizing duals is claimed.
An unindexed correction may contain the same observation.
title: The extremal dual norm in a continuous \(K\)-\(g\)-frame theorem is reciprocal
